title: 第003章 黑煞骨墨上品斩邪符成第004章 符箓太强邪修直呼不讲武德
slug: 九叔饲养百倍返还僵尸成旱魃
content_zh:
任家镇街头巷尾有几只流浪黑狗，平日里抢食打架，凶得很。
苏辰偶尔拿剩饭剩骨头喂过它们几回，其中有两只已经和他很熟悉了。
黑狗血本就是驱邪破煞的好东西。
若是养上一只，说不准能返还更好的东西！
苏辰想到这里，起身就往外走。
他推门出去时，已是午后，前院那边传来窸窸窣窣的说话声。
秋生和文才缩在门边，不知道又在鬼鬼祟祟琢磨什么。
见苏辰从后院出来，两人立刻站直了些，脸上挤出笑。
“大师兄——”
“师兄，你这是要出去啊？”
苏辰扫了他们一眼，点点头：“出去一趟。”
秋生眼珠子一转，开口问道，“我也闲着无聊，能不能跟你一起去？”
苏辰目光在秋生和文才身上打量，总觉得他们又在搞什么小动作。
为了避免惹火上身，他果断的摇了摇头，“师父明天就回来了，你和文才还是赶紧把院子打扫一番，省的师父回来挨骂。”
听到苏辰的话，秋生沮丧的低下了头，“好吧......”
从义庄出来，苏辰拐了两条街，很快就在一处破墙边看到了那几只黑狗。
三只狗正围着一堆骨头撕扯。
见有人靠近，其中两只立刻呲牙，喉咙里滚出低低的呜声。
只有最右边那只抬头看了苏辰一眼，鼻子嗅了嗅，尾巴轻轻摆了两下。
“还认得我。”

苏辰笑了一声，抬手把刚买来的半只烧鸡丢了过去。
香味一散，三只黑狗顿时扑了上去。
系统光幕也随之浮现。
【检测到兽类生灵。】
【黑狗：灰色品质】
【黑狗：灰色品质】
【黑狗：灰色品质】
“只有灰色品质吗？可惜......”
苏辰口中一叹，接着目光一扫，很快挑中了那只最壮的。
那狗通体黑亮，四肢修长，牙口齐整，脑门中间还有一撮短毛微微竖起，眼神比另外两只更凶，抢食时动作也更快。
“就你了。”
苏辰趁它埋头啃鸡腿时，一把按住它后颈。
黑狗猛地一惊，身子刚要挣，苏辰意念一动，直接把它收进了兽类栏位。
随后快步离开了此地。
而当其余两只黑狗分食完烧鸡之后，抬头看向四周：？？？不是，我兄弟呢？
灵虚界中，苏辰站在兽栏边上，眼前闪烁着蓝色的光幕。
【检测到灰色品质生灵：黑毛犬。】
【是否绑定于兽类栏位？】
“是。”
苏辰毫不犹豫点下。

下一瞬，兽类栖地立刻起了变化。
content_en:
There are a few stray black dogs in the streets of Renjia Town. They usually fight for food and are very vicious.
Su Chen occasionally fed them with leftover bones a few times, and two of them were already very familiar with him.
The black dog is a good tool to ward off evil spirits.
If you raise one, you might be able to return something better!
Su Chen thought of this, got up and walked out.
When he opened the door and went out, it was already afternoon, and rustling voices could be heard from the front yard.
Qiu Sheng and Wen Cai were huddled by the door, wondering what they were secretly thinking about.
Seeing Su Chen coming out of the backyard, the two of them immediately stood up straighter, with smiles on their faces.
"Elder brother——"
"Brother, are you going out?"
Su Chen glanced at them and nodded: "Go out."
Qiu Sheng rolled his eyes and asked, "I'm also bored, can I go with you?"
Su Chen looked at Qiu Sheng and Wen Cai, always feeling that they were up to something.
In order to avoid getting angry, he shook his head decisively, "Master will be back tomorrow. You and Wencai should clean up the yard quickly to save Master from being scolded when he comes back."
Hearing Su Chen's words, Qiu Sheng lowered his head in frustration, "Okay..."
After coming out of Yizhuang, Su Chen turned two streets and soon saw the black dogs beside a broken wall.
Three dogs were tearing around a pile of bones.
Seeing someone approaching, two of them immediately bared their teeth and let out a low whine from their throats.
Only the one on the far right looked up at Su Chen, sniffed, and wagged its tail slightly.
"You still recognize me."
Su Chen laughed, raised his hand and threw away the half roast chicken he just bought.
As soon as the scent dissipated, three black dogs pounced on it.
The system light curtain also appeared.
[Beast creatures detected. 】
[Black Dog: Gray Quality]
[Black Dog: Gray Quality]
[Black Dog: Gray Quality]
"Is there only gray quality? What a pity..."
Su Chen sighed, then glanced around and quickly picked the strongest one.
The dog was all black and shiny, with slender limbs, neat teeth, and a tuft of short hair standing slightly in the middle of its forehead. Its eyes were more fierce than the other two, and it moved faster when grabbing food.
"It's just you."
Su Chen held down the back of its neck while it was munching on chicken legs.
The black dog was startled suddenly, and just as he was about to pull away, Su Chen took it into the animal stall with a thought.
Then he quickly left the place.
And when the other two black dogs finished eating the roast chicken, they looked up and looked around:? ? ? No, where is my brother?
In the spiritual void world, Su Chen stood beside the animal pen, with a blue light curtain flashing in front of his eyes.
[Gray quality creature detected: black-haired dog. 】
[Is it bound to the beast slot? 】
"Yes."
Su Chen clicked without hesitation.
The next moment, the beast's habitat immediately changed.
